warning_source: Western Negev local-authority heads; Tamir Idan / Sdot Negev Regional Council
recipient: Benjamin Netanyahu (then PM and defense minister); Defense Ministry director-general; deputy chief of staff reportedly aware
warning_summary: Warned that weakening the National Emergency Authority and transferring responsibility to Home Front Command was damaging emergency governance; Idan said Home Front projects in his council had been frozen and that local leaders could not work effectively without NEMA.
evidence_state: Shakuf's 18 Oct 2023 investigation reproduces the 2019 warning chain: an August 2019 letter by western-Negev local heads to Netanyahu, an earlier complaint by Idan to the Defense Ministry DG, and Idan's contemporaneous Radio Darom interview saying senior defense officials knew of the dysfunction. The original letter/interview recording has not yet been recovered.
gaps: Recover the August 2019 letter and Radio Darom recording/transcript; establish exact warning wording, all signatories/recipients, and whether the inherited emergency-governance risk was later repeated or formally carried into the 2022-23 government. Current evidence supports investigation, not publication.
run_note: New older-warning lead; no Accepted event created.
